title: add-perspective-weighted-eval-gate-and-selective-replay-hook
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: standard aggregate eval gates (mean / median-based) can mask systematic, perspective-driven regressions where a model drifts at the cohort-level for a particular annotator perspective (e.g. cultural framing, domain expertise). This PR introduces a lightweight perspective-weighted scoring function and a CI gate that uses stratified bootstrapped confidence intervals across perspective clusters to surface regressions that would otherwise be attenuated by averaging. It also adds a selective-replay hook that schedules targeted re-evals for failing perspectives with deterministic sampling for reproducibility.

What this change contains: perspective clustering (unsupervised seed + optional annotation tag), per-perspective metric aggregation, perspective-weighted composite score, CI gate implementation wired into the existing CI hooks, and a selective replay orchestration that backfills failing cohorts with configurable retry/backoff. The gate supports both soft-fail (annotate + notify) and hard-fail (block PR) modes and is enabled by default in soft-fail in CI.

Design notes and tradeoffs: we avoid heavy-weight per-annotator modeling to keep runtime cheap in CI; clustering is done with a small TF-IDF + PCA + mini-batch k-means step (implemented in Python, optional C-extension path for speed). Bootstrapped CIs use stratified resampling to maintain perspective weights. Default thresholds are conservative and tied to historical variance estimates; ops can opt-in to tighter thresholds via repo config (eval/config/perspective_gate.yaml).

Testing and rollout: unit tests for metric math, integration tests that run the gate against synthetic perspective-shifted fixtures, and an e2e smoke test in CI that exercises the selective replay flow. Rollout plan: enable soft-fail for two weeks, monitor rate of perspective hits and false-positives, then flip to hard-fail for critical prompt-sets. Linear ENG-2109 tracks rollout and telemetry dashboards.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to default cluster counts and sampling seed determinism. The PR includes a small performance regression on per-eval-run time (~+12% for very large prompt-sets) — this is a conscious tradeoff for stronger safety signals and is mitigated by caching the cluster assignments between runs.

+class PerspectiveGate(CIGate):
+    def evaluate(self, run):
+        buckets = cluster_assignment(run.examples)
+        ci = stratified_bootstrap(buckets, metric_fn, n_resamples=1000)

review_thread: Aaron Blake: This is promising — can you justify k=6 as the default? In some prompt-sets we only see 2-3 semantic perspectives.
Priya Natarajan: Good call — default is conservative; I added autodetect logic in the latest patch to fall back to silhouette-based k selection when example count > 200.
Sandeep Rao: Concerned about CI runtime increase. Can we gate the clustering behind an environment flag so the heavy path only runs in nightly or on-demand?
Priya Natarajan: Added EVAL_PERSPECTIVE_MODE which accepts 'fast'|'full' — 'fast' uses cached assignments or a precomputed lightweight sketch. Documented in config and default CI uses 'fast'.
Elena Markov: Tests look good. Suggest adding a small example in docs showing a perspective-specific regression and the selective replay output (who/what got retried).
Priya Natarajan: Added example fixture and screenshot in docs in the latest commit.
ci_checks: initial CI: some flaky integration tests failed (test_replay_scheduler timeout) -> rerun CI after timeout fix -> all checks passed. Matrix: py38, py39, lint, unit, integration (fast). Coverage: new code covered at ~82% by unit tests.
performance_impact: +12% median walltime for large prompt-sets (>5k examples) when running full clustering; 'fast' mode shows <2% overhead. Added caching to mitigate repeated runs.
rollout_notes: Enable soft-fail by default for 14 days. Monitor 'perspective_hits' and 'false_positive_rate' dashboards (dashboards/eval/perspective). After validation, flip the gate to hard-fail for 'core' prompt-sets listed in eval/config/core_prompt_sets.txt.
release_notes: Introduce perspective-weighted evaluation gate and selective replay hook: better detection of perspective-specific regressions, stratified bootstrap CIs, configurable fast/full CI modes, rollout in soft-fail initially.
post_merge_tasks: (1) Add a telemetry pipeline to emit per-perspective deltas (ENG-2184). (2) Schedule a nightly job to recompute cluster cache. (3) Update ops runbook for gate flips.
backcompat: This change is non-breaking for existing configs; new behavior is opt-in for hard-fail and defaults to soft-fail. API surface for metrics functions remains stable.
notes_for_ops: If CI begins to flag many perspectives, increase the quiet window or adjust thresholds in eval/config/perspective_gate.yaml. For immediate suppression, set mode: fast in repo CI variables.
